description: This file defines a handler for interacting with Anthropic models on Google Vertex AI, including configuration class, request/response transformation, and custom error handling.

classes.name: VertexAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class to handle HTTP errors specific to Vertex AI integrations, capturing status code, message, request and response details.

classes.name: VertexAIAnthropicConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interfacing with Vertex AI's Anthropic API, including request/response transformation and model support checking.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the name of the custom language model provider, here identifying 'vertex_ai'.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the request data before it's sent to Vertex AI, adjusting parameters and handling tool-based modifications.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw response from Vertex AI into a structured ModelResponse object.

methods.name: bool is_supported_model(cls, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a given model is supported by the Vertex AI Anthropic API based on model name and provider.
